newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY-SPRINGBOKS' SMALL,TEICHMANN FIT TO FACE LIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-SPRINGBOKS' SMALL,TEICHMANN FIT TO FACE LIONS.

text.p: Captain Gary Teichmann and wing James Small have been passed fit to play for South Africa in the first match of the three-test series against the British Lions in Cape Town on Saturday.
The pair limped out of the Springboks' 74-14 warm-up win over Tonga with hamstring injuries on Tuesday.
But they were included when coach Carel du Plessis named his side in Cape Town on Sunday.
The team shows only one change to the combination which scored 12 tries against Tonga. Fit-again lock Mark Andrews replaces Fritz van Heerden.
Du Plessis was in Durban on Saturday to see the British Lions' 42-12 victory over Currie Cup champions Natal.
"I'm not concerned by that," he said on Sunday. "I have always said they are a strong test combination but we have analysed their strengths and weaknesses and I'm confident we can beat them."
Du Plessis added that all the injuries had cleared up to his satisfaction and he saw no reason to make major changes.
The win over Tonga, du Plessis's first match in charge, extended the Springboks' winning run to seven matches.

South Africa - 15-Andre Joubert, 14-James Small, 13-Japie Mulder, 12-Edrich Lubbe, 11-Andre Snyman, 10-Henry Honiball, 9-Joost van der Westhuizen, 8-Gary Teichmann (captain), 7-Andre Venter, 6-Ruben Kruger, 5-Hannes Strydom, 4-Mark Andrews, 3-Adrian Grvey, 2-Naka Drotske, 1-Os du Randt.
Replacements: Russell Bennett, Krynauw Otto, Boeta Wessels, Werner Swanepoel, James Dalton, Dawie Theron.
